courses.title: MRes Media, Communication and Creative Practice
courses.overview: Combines creative practice with rigorous academic research in media and film.
courses.modules: Creative Practice Methods, Thesis

courses.title: MSc (Research) Geography
courses.overview: Research in physical or human geography, glaciology, or earth observation.
courses.modules: Geographical Research Skills, Thesis

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Criminology and Sociology
courses.overview: Explores the causes of crime and the social structures of the criminal justice system.
courses.modules: Criminal Justice, Social Theory, Victims and Society, Policing

courses.title: BVSc Veterinary Science
courses.overview: Joint degree with the Royal Veterinary College; 2 years in Aberystwyth and 3 in London.
courses.modules: Animal Husbandry, Pathology, Clinical Medicine, Surgery
courses.entry_requirements: AAA at A-level including Biology and Chemistry; IELTS 7.0.

courses.title: MSc Environmental Management
courses.overview: Addressing environmental challenges through sustainable policy and land management.
courses.modules: Environmental Law, GIS, Sustainability Assessment, Climate Policy

courses.title: MSc Psychology (Conversion)
courses.overview: BPS-accredited conversion course for non-psychology graduates wishing to enter the field.
courses.modules: Cognitive Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Biological Psychology

courses.title: MA Digital Media Production
courses.overview: Focused on high-level production skills for digital filmmaking and television.
courses.modules: Cinematography, Digital Editing, Scriptwriting, Media Practice

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Nursing (Adult)
courses.overview: Professional practice degree leading to registration as an adult nurse.
courses.modules: Clinical Skills, Health Assessment, Pharmacology, Nursing Theory

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Nursing (Mental Health)
courses.overview: Focuses on the delivery of evidence-based mental health nursing care.
courses.modules: Psychiatric Nursing, Clinical Skills, Ethics, Crisis Management

courses.title: BA (Hons) Modern Languages (French and Spanish)
courses.overview: Includes a mandatory year abroad in a Francophone or Hispanic country.
courses.modules: Language Skills, Culture and Society, Translation, Film Studies

courses.title: MSc Business Psychology
courses.overview: Applying psychological principles to improve organizational effectiveness.
courses.modules: Consumer Psychology, Organizational Behaviour, HRM, Leadership

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Psychology and Marketing
courses.overview: Unique combination exploring consumer behavior through a scientific psychological lens.
courses.modules: Consumer Psychology, Social Psychology, Digital Marketing, Branding

courses.title: MSc Agrifood Innovation
courses.overview: Focused on the development of new products and sustainable processes in the agrifood sector.
courses.modules: Food Safety, Innovation Management, Agri-Supply Chain

courses.title: BA (Hons) History and Heritage
courses.overview: Focused on historical research combined with museum and heritage site management.
courses.modules: Public History, Heritage Management, Historiography, Archival Research

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Geology
courses.overview: Scientific study of the Earth's solid materials and their evolution over time.
courses.modules: Mineralogy, Structural Geology, Paleontology, Field Geology

courses.title: BSc (Hons) Physics with Astronomy
courses.overview: Explores the physics of the universe with a focus on astronomical observation.
courses.modules: Astrophysics, Quantum Mechanics, Observational Astronomy, Cosmology

courses.title: MSc Agrifood Innovation (Distance Learning)
courses.overview: A flexible part-time master's focusing on sustainable agrifood supply chains.
courses.modules: Sustainable Production, Food Safety, Supply Chain Innovation

courses.title: MSc Human Resource Management
courses.overview: Accredited program focused on strategic and ethical people management.
courses.modules: Strategic HRM, Employment Law, Employee Relations, L&D

courses.title: MSc Digital Marketing
courses.overview: Focused on consumer data analytics and online brand management strategy.
courses.modules: Digital Strategy, SEO, Social Media Marketing, Web Analytics

courses.title: MSc Bioengineering
courses.overview: Technical application of biological principles to engineering solutions.
courses.modules: Bioprocessing, Medical Technology, Research Skills, Engineering Design

courses.title: MSc Pharmaceutical Sciences
courses.overview: Advanced study of drug development, analysis, and pharmaceutical technology.
courses.modules: Drug Discovery, Pharmacology, Pharmaceutics, Research Methods

courses.title: PhD Politics
courses.overview: High-level doctoral research in political theory and comparative systems.
courses.modules: Doctoral Thesis, Political Analysis, Research Ethics
